algorithm: Compress the distinct GCD values of adjacent-difference suffixes, keeping the earliest start for each.
correctness_argument: Equal residues modulo m are equivalent to m dividing every adjacent difference. Thus a nontrivial subarray is valid exactly when its difference GCD exceeds one. Extending all suffix GCD states enumerates every candidate, and equal GCD states may keep only their earliest start.
problem_understanding: Convert congruence equality into divisibility of adjacent differences.

steps.claim: Convert congruence equality into divisibility of adjacent differences.
steps.rationale: Convert congruence equality into divisibility of adjacent differences.

steps.claim: GCD one permits a common modulus at least two.

steps.claim: Implementation follows these obligations: Convert congruence equality into divisibility of adjacent differences. A common modulus at least two exists iff GCD>1. Each suffix state retains its earliest possible start. Extending and merging GCD states covers all subarrays. A single element always forms a friend group.
